title: Kenyan Tripe Curry
description: A spicy and flavorful curry made with tender tripe, Kenyan spices, and a hint of aerated sweetness.

ingredients.name: Tripe
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: Kenyan spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most Indian grocery stores

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion, ginger, and garlic. Cook until the onion is lightly browned.
Add tripe and cook until browned on all sides.
Add Kenyan spice blend, turmeric, salt, and bisque powder (if using). Cook for 1 minute.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1.5 hours or until tripe is tender.
Stir in aerated vinegar and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve hot with rice or roti.
